themes_detail.label: Abandoned Cars Surge
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints spiked to 26 THIS WEEK, up 225% from the 8-week average of 8.0 per week (z-score: 6.69), suggesting a sudden influx of abandoned or non-operational vehicles clogging streets in CD 205.
evidence: 26 derelict vehicle complaints THIS WEEK vs. 8.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Highest z-score among all active spikes in the district
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD Tow Unit or Sanitation about sudden increase—are they aware of coordinated dumping or enforcement gaps?
Canvas Fordham/University Heights blocks to map cluster—are abandoned cars concentrated in specific neighborhoods?

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Increase
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use violations jumped to 8 complaints THIS WEEK, a 156% spike from the 8-week average of 3.1 per week (z-score: 4.18), reflecting potential illegal occupancy, overcrowding, or unsafe dwelling conditions.
evidence: 8 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
282 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days (147 alterations), suggesting active construction/occupancy changes
reporting_angles: Request DOB inspection list for CD 205 to identify which buildings are flagged—are conversions or subdivisions occurring?
Interview HPD enforcement about uptick—are there known bad-actor landlords or buildings of concern?

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Decay
themes_detail.summary: Three separate infrastructure complaints emerged THIS WEEK: Street Sign Missing (380% spike to 3 complaints vs. 0.6 avg) and Outside Building violations (243% spike to 3 complaints vs. 0.9 avg), indicating deteriorating public realm conditions.
evidence: Street Sign Missing: 3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 3.41)
Outside Building: 3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 3.54)
Both spikes cluster in same timeframe, suggesting systemic maintenance failure
reporting_angles: Walk key intersections in Fordham and University Heights to document missing/damaged street signs—gap in visibility/navigation?
Contact NYCDDOT about maintenance schedule—are signs being stolen or is repair backlog widening?

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Incidents (Trailing)
themes_detail.summary: Food Poisoning complaints hit 4 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 967% spike from the 8-week average of 0.4 per week (z-score: 5.21), though this spike has already aged; monitor whether similar reports resurface in current week.
evidence: 4 food poisoning complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No current-week confirmation of sustained pattern
reporting_angles: Request DOHMH inspection records for CD 205 restaurants in past 3 weeks—which establishments had violations or closures?
Interview local health department about whether cluster was traced to specific venue or supplier

themes_detail.label: Unsheltered Population Clustering (Trailing)
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints reached 13 THREE WEEKS AGO, a 373% spike from the 8-week average of 2.8 per week (z-score: 4.3); trend requires confirmation this week to determine if sustained or resolved.
evidence: 13 encampment complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community board budget requests include 'Other programs to address public health issues' (recurring ask suggests chronic need)
reporting_angles: Canvass parks and transit hubs (e.g., Fordham Rd, University Ave corridors) to document current encampment locations and scale
Interview NYPD and DHS outreach teams about whether 3-week-ago cluster has been dispersed or stabilized
